Thunderbird is a free, open-source program. No donation is required to download, install, or use the program. Whether or not you fell into a scam, I can't say, but unless you downloaded Thunderbird from a non-official site (the primary source is < https://www.thunderbird.net/en-US/thunderbird/all/ > your inability to send is not related to your donation.

If you want to cancel an official donation, go here:

https://give.thunderbird.net/hc/en-us/articles/49703731547667-Cancellations-and-Refunds
